specNotes: materials of different kinds: the first render must show the material the selector says is selected, and every material must show its own price.

The marker for each material is derived by the harness from that material's own title, and index 0 is measured on the FIRST render, before any selection control is clicked — which is exactly the state where a whole-array search for one preferred material kind disagrees with a selector initialised at index 0.
